graph/description: **Would AlphaMissense have told the clinic?** The reviewed ClinVar classifications (at least one star) of the changes one DNA letter can make, against AlphaMissense's score $s$, which was trained without ClinVar's labels; its classes are *likely benign* for $s < 0.34$ and *likely pathogenic* for $s > 0.564$. The pathogenic pile at the right and the benign at the left barely overlap. Below them, the variants of uncertain significance (VUS): where a prediction is most useful and least proven. *Be aware:* some classifications made since 2023 may cite AlphaMissense, and TP53's are also informed by functional assays.
graph/name: Would it have told the clinic? ClinVar against AlphaMissense
